messages:
Maya R.: Heads up — Nova wants to finalize their dedicated commit for Q3. They sent a draft: 1.2M GPU-hours/month baseline with a 10% burst allowance. They asked for a clear buffer policy, regional guarantees (APAC), and fallback behavior if we run out of capacity. Meeting with CSM tomorrow.
Sam T.: Quick sanity check math — 1.2M GPU-hrs/mo: what's the expected 24/7 equivalent? Need workload mix (seq lengths / avg tokens) to translate to GPUs.
Maya R.: They provided a high-level mix: 70% short completions (avg seq 128), 25% multi-turn chat (avg seq 1024), 5% embeddings. Latency SLOs are ~200–500ms tail for conversational flows.
Kevin L.: Back-of-envelope:
```
1.2M GPU-hrs / month ≈ 40 GPUs @ 24/7 (1 GPU = 720 hrs/mo)
With 10% burst -> ~44 GPUs
Add ~15% maintenance/failover headroom -> ~50 GPUs reserved
```
So pinned to APAC we'd need ~50 GPUs capacity there.
Anil P.: Important: ap-southeast-1 capacity is constrained. Lead time to provision 32 GPUs there is currently ~6–8 weeks unless we accept mixed-region placement. Mixed-region = routing latency penalty.
Leah F.: Cost context: our committed rate (internal reference) already discounts baseline. If Nova wants 20% buffer pinned to APAC instead of 10% we estimate ~+8% on effective monthly invoice due to lower utilization efficiency.
ops-bot: Capacity scan complete. ap-southeast-1 free pool: 18 GPUs. us-west-2 free pool: 60 GPUs. Estimated provisioning lead time for 32 GPUs in ap-southeast-1: 49 days.
Sam T.: Suggest we present two formal options to Nova:
A) Baseline 1.2M + 10% burst + cross-region fallback to US (lower cost, potential 10–30ms p95 hit, depends on routing).
B) Baseline 1.2M + 20% pinned buffer in ap-southeast-1 (higher cost, keeps regional SLOs and avoids cross-region traffic).
Maya R.: Also want an ops clause: automatic failover to hosted API for overflow traffic with a configurable cap and rate-limits, plus a 30-day rolling review for reserved sizing (ability to adjust linearly with 30d notice).
Kevin L.: For the fallback path we should pre-warm a lighter model variant and KV caches. Proposed warmup: 15 minutes of targeted preheat when fallback flips to reduce cold-start token latency.
Anil P.: Networking note: cross-region routing adds roughly +8–12ms median and +25–40ms p95 on our tests; need a run targeted at Nova's endpoints to validate. Also check egress and peering costs for sustained overflow.
Sam T.: Action items: (1) Maya to send Nova both options + plain-language tradeoffs and the approximate cost delta by EOD. (2) Kevin to run a capacity simulation for three configs (10% burst pinned, 20% pinned, 10% burst + cross-region) and post numbers. (3) Anil to run a networking latency/egress estimate against Nova's test endpoints by tomorrow.
Maya R.: Thanks — tagging @Kevin L. and @Anil P. I'll loop in finance/CSM after we have numbers. :thumbsup:
